title: Minimum Elements to Add to Form a Given Sum
goal: Find the fewest bounded-magnitude values to append so the sum equals goal.
strategy: Compute the signed sum gap. Each appended value closes at most limit of its magnitude, and a smaller final remainder is permitted.
